tldr: Amazon is blocking Meta's Muse agent from shopping on Amazon.com. SoftBank is raising more than $11 billion in high-interest bonds to buy more OpenAI stock. AI-written code made up 17.25% of Linux kernel patches this September. MiniMax put its terminal coding agent on GitHub under a free licence. Claude Code now reads AGENTS.md files and can run many cloud coding threads at once.

articles.title: Amazon blocks Meta's Muse agent from shopping on its store
articles.summary: Muse users now hit a popup saying an unauthorised AI agent breaks Amazon's terms. Amazon says Meta never agreed the access.

articles.title: SoftBank seeks over $11B in junk bonds for its next OpenAI tranche
articles.summary: A $10B third tranche closes 1 October, taking its OpenAI stake to about 13%. The bond is expected to price on Thursday.

articles.title: AI-written code reached 17.25% of Linux kernel patches in September
articles.summary: 1,634 AI submissions in the last week alone, up from 3% of patches in February. Maintainers say review time is the cost.

articles.title: MiniMax open-sources its terminal coding agent under MIT
articles.summary: MiniMax Code v0.4.12 ships a terminal UI, a headless mode for CI and editor support, and accepts your own API keys. Desktop app not included.

articles.title: Claude Code 2.1.277 adds AGENTS.md support and a proxy-egress gateway flag
articles.summary: When a project has no CLAUDE.md, the CLI now reads AGENTS.md. CLAUDE.md still wins when both exist; Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry unsupported.

articles.title: Claude Code Projects becomes a coordinator over parallel cloud threads
articles.summary: One prompt spawns cloud sessions on their own branches that report back to a coordinator. Capped at 200 new threads per project per day in beta.

articles.title: Kimi K3.1 teased with 135 digits of pi on Moonshot's Zhihu account
articles.summary: No K3.1 identifier appears on any Moonshot surface, so this is a signal rather than a release. K3 remains the shipping model.

articles.title: Hermes plugin catalog goes live with a page per plugin
articles.summary: Each plugin now gets its own page with its readme, plus sort-by-recent and browse-by-author views.

articles.title: "MCP was always a bad idea?" argues the protocol overreached
articles.summary: The most argued-about agent-tooling post of the weekend: 135 points and 110 comments on Hacker News.

articles.title: Kev: a tiny Jev-like family of decision models built on Qwen3.5
articles.summary: An open attempt at typed decision output instead of generated text. 155 points and 71 comments on Hacker News.

articles.title: Gewell: a Gemma 4 inference engine for Blackwell GPUs
articles.summary: Built to run Gemma 4 31B under high concurrency on Blackwell cards, filling the gap ninfer left for Gemma.
